records.plain_description: Turn an explicit graph, budgets and closures into a checked immutable planning state.

ports.name: payload
ports.constraints: Exact dict keys nodes, edges, start, goal, budgets, blocked_nodes, blocked_edges, max_expansions. Nodes and closure lists contain unique nonempty strings; endpoints refer to known nodes. Edges are dicts with exactly id, source, target, cost, resources; edge IDs unique, cost and resource entries nonnegative Python integers excluding bool. Budgets are a nonempty nonnegative integer list, aligned with every resource vector; max_expansions is a positive integer. Closures reference existing identities. Cost and resources are additive. Input is detached into immutable state.

ports.name: state
ports.constraints: Trusted immutable State produced by encode_state: unique nonempty node/edge identities, known endpoints, nonnegative integer costs and resource vectors aligned to nonempty finite budgets, explicit closures and positive expansion limit. Caller supplies cost, resource and closure meaning; no intrinsic physical units or domain schema.

validity_bounds: Finite directed graph with nonnegative integer additive costs and nonnegative integer resource consumption only.
Budget-state products may be large. Expansion limits do not bound peak queue memory or wall-clock latency.
Trusted in-process stage objects only. Arbitrary manually forged states and portable intermediate interchange are not qualified.
Node labels, costs, units and closures are caller policy. No automatic domain ingestion or arbitrary simulation.
Synthetic automated Tier 3 evidence; no historical competition accuracy, human Tier 1 review or production scale claim.

records.plain_description: Find a least-cost feasible route, prove none exists by exhausting the queue, or report that the search limit was reached.

ports.name: candidates
ports.constraints: Trusted Candidates produced by generate_candidates, retaining original State and all directed edges not blocked and individually within budgets. Cumulative resource feasibility is determined during search; candidates are transitions, not complete routes.

ports.name: searched
ports.constraints: Trusted SearchResult produced by search_routes. Status optimal, infeasible or search_limit; original Candidates retained. Optimal contains ordered edge identities, integer cost, consumed-resource tuple and expansion count. Infeasible means queue exhaustion or blocked boundary. Search_limit makes no feasibility claim. Intermediate non-success cost/resource placeholders must not be interpreted as a feasible zero-cost route.

Optimal paths have independently checked continuity, closures, goal, totals and budgets against the original State. ports.constraints: Strict JSON dict with status, edge_ids, cost, resources, expansions. Optimal returns ordered edges and exact integer totals; start equals goal permits an empty route unless blocked. Other statuses return empty edge_ids and null cost/resources. Equal-cost ties follow transition/insertion order; no secondary resource optimum. No named competition submission format.
